Peterson family · Person

Johannes Gustaf Pettersson

1846–1911

Open in the family tree

Born
May 31, 1846 · Vaksala, Uppsala, Sweden
Died
October 8, 1911 · Salina, Utah
Burial
Pioneer Cemetery, Salina, Utah

Born May 31, 1846, in Vaksala, Uppsala, Sweden, to Per Andersson and Greta Stina Jonsson Jansdotter. Married Ericka Munter on October 18, 1873, in Rasbo. Their family group lists eight children. He died October 8, 1911, in Salina, Utah, and was buried in Pioneer Cemetery.

Family connections

Parents Greta Stina Jonsson Jansdotter, Per Andersson

Grandparents Anders Persson, Anna Caisa Zacrisdotter, Anna Greta Pehrsdotter, Jan Ersson

Spouses and partners Ericka Munter

Children with Ericka Munter: August Emanuel Leonard Peterson, Erik Hilmer Pettersson, Ida Gustava Pettersson, Johan Axel Peterson, Josef Pettersson, Karl Gustaf Pettersson, Maria Pettersson, Signy Pettersson

Siblings Johan Robert Persson (Full sibling) · Josefina Perhrsson Anderson (Full sibling) · Margreta Catharina Pehrsson Anderson (Full sibling) · Maria Christina Pehrsson Anderson (Full sibling) · Per Erik Persson Eklund (Full sibling)
